## What I Do

Julianna Head works with wellness and hospitality companies, professional services firms, consumer/DTC brands, and growth-stage companies. She finds where revenue leaks out of funnels and operations, then designs the fix, builds it, markets it, measures it, and keeps improving it herself.

## Services

- Web & app development, software consulting
- UI/UX design, graphic design, brand systems
- SEO, digital marketing, Google & Meta ads, lead generation
- Data analysis, marketing analytics, performance analytics
- Digital product management, consulting, digital operations
- CRM architecture (GoHighLevel), marketing automation, lifecycle workflows
- VoIP/IVR systems, content creation, video, photography
- Hiring & recruiting, grant & book editing
